currentFocus: Measuring how RuneSpace artwork is actually delivered on the live site, then fixing what the measurements found: artwork that loaded last instead of first, and Map location identifiers that were sent as oversized files.

currentChange.summary: The location scene and the speaking character's portrait now load first instead of last, and the Map's location identifiers are far smaller files, so artwork arrives noticeably sooner on a phone.

latestCompleted.summary: Added the optional side Mission Out of the Weather: repair Holo Hollow's Crew Stop with Welding, and the mining crews start letting you ride out to The Jag for 5 Credits.

nextStep: Human review of PR #188, including loading RuneSpace on a real phone to judge whether the artwork actually feels faster.

highlights.summary: Added Map MISSION and TURN IN destinations, blue turn-in guidance, compact Mission strips at the top of Play, and visible keyboard focus on beveled controls.
Extracted generic Play orchestration from the Mining feature into its own server and client boundary.
Made dialogue lifecycle aware of active versus completed state and one-shot presentation.
